The structure of NaMg₄ (Na₄Mg₁₆ per unit cell) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 20 atoms distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for both elements: each Mg center has 12 geometric neighbors (8 Mg, 4 Na), while each Na center has 12 Mg neighbors, with distances of 3.1268–3.1277 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows Mg–Mg 12-vertex coordination polyhedra sharing corner, edge, and face contacts, and Mg–Na polyhedra sharing edges.
